labels.notes: Unmarked, as the dispatch requires. There is no bold-backtick label form anywhere in scaffold/CausalScaffold/BubbleK.lean. The first 4000 characters cite `rem:K_neq_I`, `prop:tarentin_fort_K` and `lem:K_facile` in plain backticks only. REPORT status 'partial', marked false: true, since the first sentence is certified elsewhere (halfChronoLine), the bubble sentence is refuted here and the BTZ sentence waits on OQ-34. PROPS. BubbleKminusAsPrinted (BubbleK.lean:469) quantifies over M : Type with TopologicalSpace, SecondCountableTopology and T2Space, and C : Causality M. The library structure carries the openness of I^±_U(x) (Causal/Causality.lean:84-88), so the class is ETT.tex:254's topological spacetimes under the standing 'equivalently' reading (kb/0014). Then C.AbsolutelyMinimal, C.Tarentin and p ∈ C.Zminus: exactly l.851-852 minus causal plainness. A bubble is B.Nonempty, IsOpen B, B ⊆ J^-(p) and B ∩ I^-(p) = ∅, which is the remark's own definition. The conclusion is (B ∩ K^-(p)).Nonempty ∧ K^-(p) ≠ I^-(p): both printed assertions. BubbleKplusAsPrinted (l.479) is the K^+ form the remark prints, read with p ∈ Z^+. The universe-0 restriction only narrows the class, so the paper's claim implies each Prop and the refutation transfers. The Ne forms have weaker conclusions, so refuting them is stronger. Not a strawman: the hypotheses are inhabited by the witness, and the refutation goes through the printed mechanism (B ∩ K^-(o) = ∅), not through a side condition. The literal hybrid reading (p ∈ Z^-, as l.852 has it, with the K^+ bubble conclusion) is not a named Prop. The REPORT's claim that the refutation holds 'in either reading' is true: an audit probe stated that Prop and refuted it from spokes_bubble_witness_future (its 5th conjunct, o ∈ dual.Zminus), then was deleted. WITNESS. spokesCausality (Ioi 0) on ℝ × ℝ (Causal/KBorelien.lean:268). ≪ is Minkowski's. ≤ is base ∨ base∘spoke∘base, and a spoke step lies in the slice t = 0 (Spokes.rel, KBorelien.lean:155). spokes_eq_or_lt_of_le therefore gives J^-(u) ⊆ {u} ∪ I^-(u) for u.1 < 0, so J^-(u_n) ⊆ I^-(o), K^-(o) ⊆ I^-(o), and with Iminus_subset_Kminus (openness of ≪ in M × M, proved as spokes_isOpen_lt) K^-(o) = I^-(o). The bubble {t < 0, -t < x} lies in J^-(o) via (t,x) ≪ (0,x) and the spoke (0,x) → o, and it is disjoint from I^-(o) = {|x| < -t}. Tarentin, absolute minimality, o ∈ Z^- and o ∈ Z^+ are library theorems. ℝ × ℝ is T2 and second countable by instance. The K^+ form uses the dual causality, a legitimate causality on ℝ × ℝ. TRUE FORM. Causality.inter_Kminus_nonempty_iff is exactly what REPORT and docstring say: for one sequence u_n → p with p ∈ Int J^+_U(u_n), an open B ⊆ J^-_U(p) meets K^-_U(p) iff some non-empty open W ⊆ B lies in ⋂_{n≥N} J^-_U(u_n). It follows from Kminus_eq_of_tendsto (lem:K_facile) and needs no tarentin, as the checklist's '⚠ weakened' row says. exists_seq_* needs only FirstCountableTopology and p ∈ Z^∓. Kminus_ne_Iminus_of_bubble is the trivial separation. On halfChronoLine_bubble_inter_Kminus, Iio(-1) is a bubble of J^-(0) that meets K^-(0). That is consistent with 'a bubble neither forces nor forbids K ≠ I', because halfChronoLine meets the Prop's hypotheses (causallyPlain_cannot_be_dropped). 'Strongest true form' is fair for an iff. FINDINGS. Finding 1 (l.872-875 false as printed) is genuine, and the by-hand ℝ × ℂ claim (J^-(o) = {t ≤ 0}) checks out. Finding 2's suggested wording matches inter_Kplus_nonempty_iff (p ∈ Int J^-(p_n), W ⊆ J^+(p_n) for all large n). Finding 3 (l.140-141) holds in the stated pointwise, sign-by-sign reading: K^-(o) = I^-(o), while spokes_not_plain_at_origin and spokes_not_pushUp_at_origin show past push-up fails at o. The reading is disclosed as a question, and the global reading is explicitly not addressed. (By hand, not formalized: K^+(o) = I^+(o) and future push-up holds at o. So the 'both signs at once' reading is refuted too, but that is not claimed.) The p = (1,0) remark (K^- ≠ I^- via spokes_mem_Kminus with ‖z‖ > 1, against I^-((1,0)) = {‖z‖ < 1} on the slice) is correct. The cited 'ETT.tex:297-298' sentence sits on l.297 alone; trivial.

findings.what: The general witness is described as meeting 'every hypothesis of prop:tarentin_fort_K but causal plainness' on ℝ × E for any real normed space E and any open cone A with a non-zero point. A topological spacetime (ETT.tex:254) must be second countable, and ℝ × E is second countable only when E is separable. The universe-0 Props also need E : Type. The Lean statement of spokes_bubble_witness claims no topological property, so nothing in Lean overclaims, and the refutations use ℝ × ℝ and ℝ × ℂ, both second countable. The prose generalisation is slightly too wide.
findings.fix: Say 'for E separable (e.g. finite-dimensional)' in the spokes_bubble_witness docstring, the module docstring and REPORT finding 1. Optionally add [SecondCountableTopology E] and a SecondCountableTopology (ℝ × E) conjunct to the general witness.
